input.summary: Repeat the Shuttle ramp through the face stages and two-ball multiball, then collect Light 1 Billion at Heartbeat when it appears.

steps.text: Take the skill shot. Trap the ball and test the Shuttle ramp from the right flipper.
Repeat the Shuttle ramp through Voice, Eye 1, and Eye 2.
modeNotes: Face stages: Each completed stage advances the Bride. Eye 2 starts two-ball multiball.

steps.text: During multiball, return balls to the Shuttle ramp for Human Influx, Metamorphosis, Face 4, and Big Wheel spins.
modeNotes: Big Wheel: A completed face can award Light 1 Billion and other values.

steps.text: When Light 1 Billion appears, shoot the Heartbeat ramp before its timer ends.
After a failed Big Wheel award, continue the Shuttle ramp and rebuild the face.

fallback.title: Unlimited Million
fallback.when: Use this plan when Light 1 Billion is unavailable, rare, or set to a very short timer.

steps.text: Continue Shuttle progress for regular Big Wheel awards.
During multiball, park one ball or hold it in the Face.
Make three consecutive Heartbeat ramps to light Unlimited Million.
modeNotes: Unlimited Million: Repeated Heartbeat shots score millions while the feature remains active.

steps.text: Use the jets when neither ramp returns safely.

alternatives.title: Quick extra ball
alternatives.when: Use this plan only when extra balls are enabled and count in the event.

steps.text: Complete the quick left-loop extra-ball route.
Then start the Shuttle-ramp plan.
Complete the face and spin the Big Wheel.
Receive Light 1 Billion.
Shoot Heartbeat before the operator-set timer ends.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Trap on the right flipper and test a same-side shot to the Shuttle ramp. Dial the angle on this copy before you repeat it.

techniques.name: Gentle multiball pass
techniques.instruction: On a controlled Shuttle return, let the ball bounce or pass to the right flipper. Trap instead when the tilt is tight.

cautions.issue: A fast Shuttle return during multiball can remove control.
cautions.response: Use a gentle bounce or pass to the right flipper. Trap instead when the tilt is tight.

cautions.issue: The Shuttle timing and backhand can differ by machine copy.
cautions.response: Dial the ramp from a catch. Do not assume the usual angle works.

noteDetails.label: Top-player proof
items: At the District 82 Super Series 2022, Jason Zahler repeatedly used the Shuttle ramp through face progress and Multiball on original Bride of Pinbot code, finishing with 43,872,380.

input.simpleOverview: Bride of Pinbot advances one repeating Shuttle ramp through the face stages and into two-ball Multiball. Keep returning to Shuttle until the Big Wheel offers Light 1 Billion, then shoot Heartbeat before its timer ends. Use three consecutive Heartbeat ramps for Unlimited Million when the Billion is unavailable.
input.overview: Bride of Pinbot is a repeating Shuttle-ramp progression through face stages, Multiball, and Big Wheel awards. Continue Shuttle through Metamorphosis and the later face stages, then collect Light 1 Billion at Heartbeat when offered. Otherwise, use Multiball control to complete three Heartbeat ramps and light Unlimited Million.
machineSetup: Confirm original Bride of Pinbot code, including L-8; exclude Dutch Pinball 2.0 rules.
Check Light 1 Billion probability and timer; operators can reduce it to 1%.
